title: High calcium found on a routine blood test; vague patient, son speaks first, nurse reads vitals, doctor lets silences sit
description: Fictional synthetic consultation for Module 3 testing; not a real patient record or medical advice.

design.opening: the son speaks first, then the patient answers a question with a question
design.patient_style: vague, everyday words for symptoms, 'the usual', 'a funny feeling'
partial_or_uncertain: the dose of her calcium or vitamin D supplement is given differently by the patient and by her son
she cannot say when she last drank enough or how often she passes water
the doctor never names a diagnosis, orders no new test beyond what is already done, and arranges no follow-up
facts: very thirsty and passing a lot of water, tired, constipated, vague aches
one calcium and vitamin D supplement (dose disputed)
tender in the belly on deep press, otherwise normal
